lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Carney says he had ‘good conversation’ with Trump regarding trade, Toronto Sun reports.
Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Abdul El-Sayed’s Republican rival Mike Rogers, The Guardian reports.

Israeli police on Sunday released two of three suspects in a case of alleged voter bribery, weakening efforts by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party to discredit last week’s parliamentary elections, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
